vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the US, there are two different ways to think about this question — **who can pay to place a company name in ChatGPT**, and **who will actually see it**.

**Who can place ads naming your company:**
Any US business can sign up for OpenAI's advertising program. In 2026, OpenAI started showing sponsored results in ChatGPT and opened a self-serve ad platform to US businesses. This is done through a **self-serve Ads Manager**, where each ad unit includes an advertiser name (brand name as registered in Ads Manager), favicon/logo, headline, description, and landing page.

Some categories face extra scrutiny: advertisers in sensitive or regulated verticals/categories, such as health and financial services, may be eligible to advertise if they meet strict eligibility criteria.

**Who actually sees your company name (ad placements):**
Not every ChatGPT user sees ads — it depends on their subscription tier. Ads currently appear below relevant ChatGPT conversations for eligible users on Free and Go plans. Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu accounts remain ad-free.

**Important distinction — paid ads vs. organic recommendations:**
Paying for an ad does **not** mean ChatGPT's actual AI-generated answer will recommend your company. No — ads do not influence ChatGPT's answers. Ads run on separate systems from the chat model, and advertisers have no ability to shape, rank, or alter ChatGPT's responses. Ads are separate and clearly labeled. Likewise, seeing an ad doesn't mean OpenAI endorses or recommends the advertiser or its products or services — ads are paid placements, not endorsements.

If you want ChatGPT's actual generated response (not just the ad slot) to name your company, that has to be earned rather than bought: ChatGPT is not going to recommend your product because you paid for an ad — the organic response the AI generates remains independent of your ad spend. Instead, you earn mentions and reviews on the sources ChatGPT trusts, publish content it can extract and cite, and keep your brand details consistent everywhere it looks, since ChatGPT recommends the brands it can find described and vouched for across the web, not the ones that simply want to be included.

**Bottom line:** Any US business can pay via OpenAI's self-serve Ads Manager to have its name/logo shown as a labeled ad to Free and Go tier ChatGPT users. But if you want your company organically *named inside ChatGPT's actual answer*, that can't be bought — it depends on how your brand is discussed and reviewed across the web that ChatGPT draws on.
